original_or_risky_claim: Broad VR review is novel because it covers many domains
literature_position: Broad VR reviews and domain-specific reviews already exist
paper_safe_claim: Contribution is the 21-workstream evidence architecture coupled to explicit comparability and provenance obligations, not breadth alone

original_or_risky_claim: The paper introduces the first framework for comparing VR evidence
literature_position: Existing reviews already discuss heterogeneity, confounding, taxonomy and reporting quality
paper_safe_claim: The paper operationalizes a six-field semantic comparability rule across the frozen evidence library

original_or_risky_claim: Most contradictions in VR are false
literature_position: The corpus supports only eight pre-specified audited contradiction families
paper_safe_claim: Seven of eight audited contradiction families were comparability-limited; this is not a prevalence estimate for all VR literature

original_or_risky_claim: A six-level taxonomy is universally complete
literature_position: Open-source/tooling and reporting literature shows multiple reproducibility failure modes but does not establish universal completeness
paper_safe_claim: The paper uses a six-level operational taxonomy to separate specification, artifact, execution, regeneration, semantic and independent-result failures

literature_position: Adaptive Redirection, SRC, F-RDW, APF-S2T, learned walkability, predictive reset and related methods occupy adaptive/predictive territory
paper_safe_claim: No new controller, selector or switching algorithm is claimed

original_or_risky_claim: One tested controller is generally superior
literature_position: Prior work and the controlled benchmark both indicate environment/context dependence
paper_safe_claim: No universal winner is supported; ordering changes across tested geometries

literature_position: Prior literature motivates tracking-area/environment dependence; present benchmark supplies controlled within-benchmark evidence
paper_safe_claim: The novel empirical value is not the idea that geometry matters, but the paired failure-aware demonstration of ordering reversals under common simulation semantics

literature_position: Completion failures make conditional reset burden alone insufficient
paper_safe_claim: Report completion and reset burden conditional on paired completion as separate estimands; do not assign synthetic scores to failures

original_or_risky_claim: Measured controller timing proves real-time superiority
literature_position: Microbenchmark excludes rendering, path planning, reset execution, I/O and device latency
paper_safe_claim: Timing quantifies relative controller-decision overhead in the common implementation/runner only

original_or_risky_claim: Lower simulated resets imply less cybersickness/better presence
literature_position: Human experience depends on exposure, measurement, participant and perceptual conditions; no live-user validation is included
paper_safe_claim: No cybersickness, presence, comfort, detectability, preference or usability conclusion is drawn from the simulation

original_or_risky_claim: VR is generally more effective for learning/health
literature_position: Reviews report promising outcomes with heterogeneity, confounding and transfer limitations
paper_safe_claim: Application claims remain task/population/outcome specific and distinguish in-VR performance from real-world transfer

original_or_risky_claim: Presence and embodiment measures are interchangeable indicators of immersion
literature_position: Foundational and recent evidence distinguishes constructs and instruments
paper_safe_claim: Presence, embodiment, agency and related measures are treated as non-interchangeable constructs

original_or_risky_claim: More humanlike avatars are generally better
literature_position: Customization, identity, animation and human likeness are distinct interventions
paper_safe_claim: Avatar effects are multidimensional and context-dependent

literature_position: Tool availability does not ensure protocol standardization, execution or semantic equivalence
paper_safe_claim: Open tooling supports executability but is not sufficient evidence of reproducibility

original_or_risky_claim: Many authentication proposals imply mature VR security
literature_position: Threat models, sensors and validation levels differ
paper_safe_claim: Proposal volume is separated from validated security effectiveness

original_or_risky_claim: The study is fully reconstructible as a database-level PRISMA review
literature_position: Raw per-database discovery yields were not preserved
paper_safe_claim: The frozen flow describes the registered curated evidence library; database-specific identification counts are not retrospectively reconstructed
